summary.en: Bayer and Google Cloud are co-building an AI radiology platform to assist radiologists with imaging analysis and intelligent search.

overview.en: Bayer and Google Cloud have collaborated for about five years to build an AI-powered radiology platform using Vertex AI, BigQuery, Healthcare API, and Chronicle. The platform flags imaging anomalies, compares current scans with prior patient history, and summarizes findings—reducing radiologist workload and expediting diagnoses. A first version for extended testing was planned for the EU and US.
overview.zh: Bayer 與 Google Cloud 攜手合作約五年，共同基於 Vertex AI、BigQuery、Healthcare API 及 Chronicle 打造 AI 放射科平台。平台可標記影像異常、將當前掃描與病患過去影像對比分析並彙整報告，減輕放射科醫師工作量並加速診斷。第一版本已計畫在歐盟與美國市場進行擴大測試。

en: AI platform flags imaging anomalies and summarizes comparisons with prior patient scans.
Built on Vertex AI, BigQuery, Healthcare API, and Chronicle over ~5 years.
Designed to reduce radiologist burnout and speed up diagnoses.
First version planned for extended testing in EU and US markets.
Supports radiologists without replacing clinical judgment—no autonomous diagnoses.
zh: AI 平台標記影像異常，並彙整與過去掃描的對比分析結果。
基於 Vertex AI、BigQuery、Healthcare API 及 Chronicle，歷經約 5 年合作構建。
旨在減輕放射科醫師過勞問題並加速診斷流程。
第一版本計畫在歐盟與美國市場進行擴大測試。

LENS engine interprets scientific papers using Gemini with contextual awareness.

summary.en: Cradle uses Google Cloud generative AI to design proteins for drug discovery, cutting experimental cycles by up to 90%.

overview.en: Cradle is a biotech startup using Google Cloud's generative AI to design proteins for drug discovery, food production, and chemical manufacturing. Traditional protein engineering requires 10–20 experimental rounds each taking 8–12 weeks; Cradle's platform cuts this by up to 90%, saving hundreds of thousands of dollars in early research. The company now runs 50+ projects and serves six of the top 25 pharma companies, including Johnson & Johnson, AbbVie, and Novo Nordisk.

Saves hundreds of thousands of dollars in early-stage R&D costs.
Serves 6 of the top 25 pharma companies including Johnson & Johnson, AbbVie, and Novo Nordisk.
